title: Special Executive Programme In Event Planning And Management
description: Gain comprehensive skills in planning, marketing, and managing successful events across the tourism and hospitality industry.
longDescription: This programme provides a deep understanding of the diverse types of events and their management, from small gatherings to mega-events. It covers essential skills, planning strategies, risk management, and the integration of marketing and ethical considerations.
courseDetails: The needs and expectations of event stakeholders Developing event objectives and goals Developing event budgets and timelines Selecting and booking event venues and vendors Creating event schedules and production plans Managing event logistics. The importance of marketing communications for different types of events and the importance of sponsorship. The target audience and their needs and interests. Developing event branding and messaging. Creating marketing and promotional materials. Identifying and using appropriate marketing channels. Measuring and analyzing marketing and promotional efforts. Marketing Trends. Managing event operations, including event setup, staffing, and execution. Addressing unexpected challenges and changes during the event. Managing event safety and security. Importance of Event Evaluation. Conducting post-event evaluations. Developing recommendations for future events based on evaluation findings. Risk management in event management. Ethical considerations in event management. Discuss legal issues in event management. Current technology trends for events management. Virtual Events. Evaluate the range of impacts that events can have on tourism destinations. Recommend measures to increase the positive impacts of events on tourism destinations Recommend measures to reduce the negative impacts of events on tourism destinations. Explore various event types, including hallmark and mega events, and their roles in the tourism and hospitality industry. Learn how to plan and organize events by setting objectives, creating budgets, and managing logistics. Develop effective marketing and promotion strategies to reach target audiences. Evaluate event success through post-event assessments and address risk management and ethical challenges in the industry. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Events and its Different Types Planning and Organizing Events Marketing and Promoting Events Executing and Evaluating Events: Risk Management and Ethical Considerations in Event Management:
